transcript.answer: Conversations began surviving an api restart on 2026-09-30. That is when issue #296 was closed, at 10:25 UTC, along with PR #300. #296 wired HAL Engine's `MongoSessionStore` into `apps/api`, replacing the engine's in-memory default, so a conversation now outlives both its socket and the process. The README confirms this: "Conversations and escalations survive a restart." I did not read PR #300 itself. The date is inferred from the #296 close time and the PR #300 document timestamp. Two related items came later. The retention sweep (#297) closed on 2026-10-20. The parent issue #23, "Persist support agent conversations beyond the process lifetime", closed on 2026-09-23.
